decision.reason: The release note [ev-589a6c291015] only says that settings were added to stabilise gateways under high traffic. The linked PR [ev-d12e18c20352] adds that these are three settings in the gateway Helm chart for tuning Deployment rollout, but the excerpt is cut off before it lists them. Only the Deployment field they feed, `spec.template.spec.terminationGracePeriodSeconds`, survives [ev-7537f6d08f98]. The changed files [ev-affc33f82dc5] show where the change lives (gateway chart values.yaml, values.schema.json and deployment.yaml), but not the new Helm value keys, their defaults, or whether existing rendered gateways change when nobody sets them. The values.yaml/deployment.yaml diff or the full PR description is needed to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
